authority: Frozen design. Same-context analysis. Grants no scientific or promotion authority.
provenance: Operator addendum 2026-08-14 to the programme question audit: 'is the Papers 1-2 mechanics the best representation of the problem?' is answered by tournament, not argument.
object: The representation choice underlying the Papers I-II mechanics (route graphs, hypergraphs, signature spaces), treated as a mutation family.

doctrine.bounded_only: RaklFormal.open_world_not_finitely_certifiable applies to representation space itself: no finite tournament certifies a 'best representation'. Every verdict is scoped to the declared contest basis, problem set and budget. The registered claim form is 'representation A dominates/loses-to/is-incomparable-with B on THIS frontier', never 'best'.
doctrine.no_scalar_winner: Endpoints are reported as a vector (solve-rate, false-derivation rate, cost, auditability); no fused score, mirroring MECH-NO-SCALAR-COLLAPSE.
doctrine.budget_matching: Both arms of a contest receive the same problem set and the same TOTAL budget (node/edge expansions and wall-time cap, both recorded). Unequal budget voids the contest.
doctrine.chronology: Problem set, arms, endpoints and budgets are frozen before either arm runs. No post-result basis expansion; a new candidate representation is a new versioned contest.

endpoints.solve_rate: MEASURED - fraction of problems solved correctly against the contest's external ground truth.
endpoints.false_derivation_rate: MEASURED - fraction of accepted solutions contradicting ground truth.
endpoints.cost: MEASURED - expansions and wall time per solved problem (CostBreakdown coordinates of src/rakl/amortization.py where applicable).
endpoints.auditability: MEASURED but typed, not graded: does a failure output mechanically name what is missing (missing premises / obstruction / blocked edge), checkable against ground truth?
endpoints.conformance_cells: Any cell true by construction is declared CONFORMANCE_not_evidence up front (SRSU-P6-CLASSIFICATION-CORRECTION-V1 precedent).

contest_1.question: What does the AND-hypergraph representation buy over OR-route-only on proof-shaped problems, and at what cost?

arms.A_or_route_only: support_solver-style binary edges; every hyperedge (P1..Pn -> C) is OR-lowered to n binary edges Pi -> C. This is the representation the implementation actually had before src/rakl/derivation.py ('the implementation only had binary edges').
arms.B_and_hypergraph: derivation.py forward closure over multi-premise hyperedges, as shipped.

contest_1.problem_set: Every theorem with >= 1 dependency in the mechanical parse of formal/RaklFormal.lean (the parse of tests/test_end_to_end_real_problem.py), derived from the axiom-free base. Frozen at commit 08169241.
contest_1.ground_truth: Kernel-checked dependency closure of the Lean development - external to both arms (the Lean kernel and axiom-freedom CI define it, the arms do not).
contest_1.held_qualitative_prior: OR is provably the wrong shape for multi-premise lemmas (a lemma needs ALL premises; derivation.py docstring), and pairwise-only distillation cannot decide global realizability (RaklFormal.no_pairwise_predicate_decides_global_realizability, bound in src/rakl/support_solver.py). The tournament does not re-litigate this; it QUANTIFIES the frontier on real data.
measured_endpoints: false-derivation rate of arm A: fraction of targets arm A accepts from a proper subset of true premises. NOT known in advance - it depends on how much of the real Lean graph is genuinely multi-premise, which is exactly the quantity of interest.
multi-premise fraction of the substrate (descriptive covariate).
cost overhead of arm B vs arm A per solved target (expansions, wall time).
auditability: does each arm's failure name the missing premise set, checked against ground truth?
conformance_cells: Arm B derives every target in the kernel closure and blocks on planted certificate corruption (already asserted in tests/test_end_to_end_real_problem.py) - CONFORMANCE, not a result of this contest.
contest_1.sign_robustness: Robust: a LOW false-derivation rate for OR (mostly single-premise substrate) is as publishable as a high one - it bounds what the hypergraph buys HERE and motivates richer substrates; a high rate quantifies the representation's necessity.
contest_1.runnability: CPU-only, minutes on laptop billy (87 nodes). Not executed inside this audit fiber; frozen for the owning lane (paper56-frontier for the Lean substrate, or main).

contest_2.question: Does a graded structural metric retrieve analogy candidates that exact shape-signature matching (analogy_retrieval v1) misses, at acceptable false-accept cost?

arms.A_exact_signature: src/rakl/analogy_retrieval.py v1: propose only on exact (relation count, degree multiset) equality.
arms.B_graded_metric: the best Stage-A-validated graded candidate from metric_open_problem/PROTOCOL_METRIC_V1.json.

contest_2.blocker: The outcome measure requires external analogy labels on natural text, which requires an admissible capable reducer (the executed Paper II negative, research/paper2_external_corpus_v1/: the current deterministic reducer is at chance). Execution is licensed only after a reducer clears admit_reducer at capability; this is the same shared blocker as Paper II's staircase and metric Stage B.

registered_non_candidates.reason: No forcing theorem: no identified residual that categorical machinery closes and the current typed representation cannot. Costume risk under the understand-before-fitting doctrine - a borrowed formalism must earn its keep against the null. Re-entry condition: a concrete residual whose closure provably requires functorial structure.

Not currently forced: finite obstruction covers (atlas_gluing) have not been shown to LOSE information that descent data preserves. RE-ENTRY CONDITION (flagged as a potential major result): exhibit a concrete gluing problem in this programme where the finite obstruction-cover representation returns the wrong verdict and sheaf descent data returns the right one. Anyone who finds such a case should document it as a first-class result, not as a footnote.

Violates the witness requirements of docs/SIMILARITY_ANALOGY_ALGEBRA.md (lexical/embedding closeness is not a structural witness; DISTANCE_GAMING failure mode) and the manifest invariant semantic_shortcut_is_structural_not_lexical.

must_not_be_claimed: 'Best representation' in any unbounded sense (open-world theorem applies to representation space).
Arm B's conformance cells as contest results.
Contest 1 results as evidence about natural-language or non-proof-shaped problems (substrate is one small kernel-checked graph).
Any Contest 2 result before the reducer blocker clears.
